item.title: Laundromat Wash-and-Fold Launch 2026: $2K/MO Add-On Real Math
item.description: An unattended laundromat maxes out at whatever revenue its walk-in customers self-generate. A store with a wash-and-fold service adds $2K–$3K/month of predictable recurring revenue on top — from customers who don’t want to spend 90 minutes doing their own laundry. For most stores, wash-and-fold is the highest-ROI service expansion available, requiring $2K–$4K in equipment + supplies + one part-time attendant, and paying back inside 4–6 months.
